title: Lots of signal related errors when AnimationTree's parent is reparented
body: ### Tested versions Reproducible in: - v4.7.rc3.mono.official [645638db9] (**Linux**) - v4.7.beta3.mono.official [860821708] (**Linux**) - v4.7.beta1.mono.official [1c8cc9e7e] (**Linux**) Reproducible only with release version. Not reproducible in: - v4.7.beta3.official [860821708] (**Linux**) - v4.7.beta3.official [860821708] (**Windows**) - v4.7.beta3.mono.official [860821708] (**Windows**) - v4.7.dev5.mono.official [a8643700c] (**Linux**) **Looks like this bug happens only in Linux mono version.** ### System information Godot v4.7.beta3.mono - Fedora Linux 44 (KDE Plasma Desktop Edition) on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 9060 XT (RADV GFX1200) - AMD Ryzen 7 9700X 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 30.48 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description In my game I'm reparenting the player character from one node to another (from top level dungeon node to level node when entering the level and back when exiting the level). When running the game in Godot editor, everything works fine without errors. But when I export the game, I get a lot of error messages which seem to be related to signals. I found out that these error are related to AnimationTree. The MRP has: - one player node and two "container" nodes (`n1_Node2D` and `n2_Node2D`). - player node has an `AnimationPlayer` with one rotation animation which is started at `_ready()` - player node has an `AnimationTree` to which I assigned a `Tree Root` and an `Anim Player`. No actual content here. By pressing buttons player node can be reparented to container nodes. - **Debug** version in Godot editor works (or at least seems to work) perfectly fine. Rotation animation continues as expected, no errors. - **Release** version, when player is reparented, prints a lot of errors: ``` ERROR: Signal 'caches_cleared' is already connected to given callable '' in that object. at: connect (core/object/object.cpp:1561) ERROR: Signal 'animation_list_changed' is already connected to given callable '' in that object. at: connect (core/object/object.cpp:1561) ERROR: Attempt to disconnect a nonexistent connection from '(res://main.tscn::AnimationLibrary_1bvp3):'. Signal: 'animation_added', callable: ''. at: _disconnect (core/object/object.cpp:1643) ERROR: Attempt to disconnect a nonexistent connection from '(res://main.tscn::AnimationLibrary_1bvp3):'. Signal: 'animation_removed', callable: ''. at: _disconnect (core/object/object.cpp:1643) ERROR: Signal 'animation_added' is already connected to given callable '' in that object. at: connect (core/object/object.cpp:1561) ERROR: Signal 'animation_removed' is already connected to given callable '' in that object. at: connect (core/object/object.cpp:1561) ERROR: Signal 'caches_cleared' is already connected to given callable '' in that object. at: connect (core/object/object.cpp:1561) ERROR: Signal 'animation_list_changed' is already connected to given callable '' in that object. at: connect (core/object/object.cpp:1561) ERROR: Attempt to disconnect a nonexistent connection from '(res://main.tscn::AnimationLibrary_1bvp3):'. Signal: 'animation_added', callable: ''. at: _disconnect (core/object/object.cpp:1643) ERROR: Attempt to disconnect a nonexistent connection from '(res://main.tscn::AnimationLibrary_1bvp3):'. Signal: 'animation_removed', callable: ''. at: _disconnect (core/object/object.cpp:1643) ERROR: Signal 'animation_added' is already connected to given callable '' in that object. at: connect (core/object/object.cpp:1561) ERROR: Signal 'animation_removed' is already connected to given callable '' in that object. at: connect (core/object/object.cpp:1561) ERROR: Signal 'caches_cleared' is already connected to given callable '' in that object. at: connect (core/object/object.cpp:1561) ERROR: Signal 'animation_list_changed' is already connected to given callable '' in that object. at: connect (core/object/object.cpp:1561) ERROR: Attempt to disconnect a nonexistent connection from '(res://main.tscn::AnimationLibrary_1bvp3):'. Signal: 'animation_added', callable: ''. at: _disconnect (core/object/object.cpp:1643) ERROR: Attempt to disconnect a nonexistent connection from '(res://main.tscn::AnimationLibrary_1bvp3):'. Signal: 'animation_removed', callable: ''. at: _disconnect (core/object/object.cpp:1643) ERROR: Signal 'animation_added' is already connected to given callable '' in that object. at: connect (core/object/object.cpp:1561) ERROR: Signal 'animation_removed' is already connected to given callable '' in that object. at: connect (core/object/object.cpp:1561) ``` Still everything seems to works. No crash, animation continues, player can be reparented again (with new error messages). ### Steps to reproduce - open MRP - **export release version** - press buttons (rotatin icon moves around) --> get errors ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [animation-test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/28233254/animation-test.zip)
